transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
Lately I keep thinking everyone would be better off if I just disappeared, and those thoughts are starting to scare me. I've just reached a point where I don't know what to do anymore.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in most activities you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with people?

Yes, absolutely. It feels like someone turned the color down on my life and I'm just moving through a gray fog where nothing feels hopeful anymore. I've stopped going to my weekend hiking club, I've been ignoring calls from my parents, and I can't even find any joy in the sustainable transportation project I used to love.
Have you had a previous episode of depression like this one, and if so, how long did it last?

I've been cycling between intense highs and crushing lows for about a year now, starting after my divorce. I've had previous "crashes" during this time, but this current dark stretch has been going on continuously for about a month.
Have you ever had periods of feeling unusually high, irritable, or energized, where you needed much less sleep but were more active or talkative than usual?

Yes, a couple of months ago I had an intense phase where I felt giddy and invincible, but also really irritable and snapped at my coworkers. I only slept about three hours a night but woke up completely wired, buzzing with so much energy that I worked through the night and reorganized my apartment at 3 a.m. I ended up taking on way too many projects at once because I just couldn't sit still.
